title: Vampire Vape Spearmint 10ml E-Liquid
description: The timeless taste of spearmint chewing gum is captured to perfection in this exquisite e-liquid from Vampire Vape. Bursting with cool, refreshing flavour, this irresistible e-liquid carries gentle floral notes, a smooth, mild candy sweetness and an uplifting touch of menthol on the exhale. This e-liquid from Vampire Vape offers a perfect balance of PG and VG, providing maximum flavour and satisfying clouds. Please note: that the 3mg nicotine strength contains 50VG/50PG while 3mg, 6mg, 12mg & 18mg nicotine strengths contain 40VG/60PG. They are versatile enough to be used with most vape devices but are ideal for low-powered starter kits , pen-vape kits and pod kits .
